certifi.requiredReview: Verify exact covered-file source, modifications, notices and distribution/source availability.

declarationConflicts.requiredReview: Reconcile the 1.136.0 wheel's LGPL-2.1-or-later declaration with the exact source semgrep.opam declaration of LGPL-2.1-only; neither declaration is automatically overridden.
Reconcile the exact 1.178.0 wheel and native root declarations; the public source revision is not proof of correspondence to privately built native payloads.

The downstream metadata-only derivative retains upstream native bytes and both license declarations. Independently determine source delivery, modification notices, applicable LGPL linking/relink terms and exact compiled-source correspondence.

semgrep.requiredReview: Verify matching native source, generated sources, pinned build submodules/scripts and dependencies, modifications, applicable linking terms and source availability. An upstream tag or Python wrapper source alone is not closure.

limitations: This tool makes no legal-approval or vulnerability-free determination.
License metadata is a declaration, not verified redistribution permission.
Lockfile membership is not proof that a dependency was compiled into a binary.
Metadata and declaration digests identify evidence bytes, not complete installed package trees.
An advisory query with no matches is not proof of vulnerability-free code, exhaustive coverage or current freshness.
Source attachments and upstream links do not by themselves prove corresponding-source completeness.
Semgrep Registry and unrelated test-rule material must not be mirrored automatically.
Resolution evidence records reviewed assertions; hashes and reviewer authorization cannot prove their semantic truth.
Security-risk acceptance preserves the finding and is not a claim that the vulnerability or source obligation ceased to exist.
Owner authorization and reviewer capabilities must be supplied outside evaluated evidence; local decisions are not trusted CI attestations.
